component: RNP patch packaging versus applied implementation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This commit adds pr2389.patch and registers it in vendoring.patches, but the checked-in elgamal.cpp blob stays bf432e1c3e9047a955460defb52494697cc39254 before and after the commit, still calling reducer.multiply. Fixed accepted source later uses (v * bg) % bp. Keep patch packaging, actual target application and later accepted comparison as separate phases. The patch comment performance number and arithmetic/security rationale were not measured or independently verified. Required primary comments 9/15 are absent, so this source finding carries zero full-audit credit.
title: Registering the RNP patch did not apply it to the checked-in Elgamal source
